subject: Approval needed: NovaMed renewal — special terms request
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@novamed.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation — usage drop + budget constraints

Hi Jonas and Monica,

Thanks again for the call earlier. I wanted to put our current position in writing so you have the context for the renewal discussion: our usage of the inference API has dropped ~35% this quarter as we paused two pilot integrations. The procurement team has flagged a 25% headcount-driven cut in the vendor renewals bucket for Q1.

NovaMed wants to stay with Redwood — the platform performance is great and our eng teams like the SDK — but we need a materially improved commercial package to keep the product live while we complete our integrations. Specifically we need: 
- A one-time credit to offset Q4 overage exposure (we estimate ~$28k)
- A price reset for the next 12 months (we're asking for a 20% unit discount given the usage drop)
- A short-term SLA uplift for critical endpoints while we migrate (we'd be willing to sign to a 6-month addendum)

We're under a hard procurement deadline: procurement wants a signed amendment or PO by Nov 20 to include in their Q4 planning. Can you advise what is possible and who needs to review?

Attaching the usage export for your review.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Alvarez
Director, Platform Partnerships
NovaMed Analytics

--- Attachment: NovaMed_usage_Q3.csv (CSV) ---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@novamed.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — usage drop + budget constraints

Sofia — thanks for the clear summary and for the usage file. Appreciate the urgency.

Quick internal note and ask for approval below — Monica and I recommend the following preservation package to avoid churn while NovaMed finishes integrations:
- One-time credit: $30,000 applied to their renewal invoice (covers the estimated Q4 exposure)
- Term reset: 12-month fixed unit price at 15% off current list (instead of the 20% they asked for)
- Temporary SLA add-on: 6-month 99.9% uptime commitment for inference endpoints with a single-step credit remedy (1% monthly credit for SLA miss, capped at $25k)

This package is slightly beyond my deal-desk authority on two items: the size of the credit ($30k) and the SLA penalty cap. Requesting executive approval to offer this as a one-time concession if leadership agrees.

If leadership approves, I will send a short amendment + PO stub for signature and ask Legal for a 6-month SLA addendum. We can include the signed PO link in HubSpot (see related link).

Request: Marissa/Vivek — can you confirm by EOD Fri Nov 10 whether we can approve the above or if we should adjust? Procurement on the customer side needs a commitment by Nov 20.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--- Attachments: NovaMed_MA_plan_v2.pdf, PO_stub_NovaMed.txt ---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — usage drop + budget constraints

Jonas — appreciate the concise package. High level thoughts:
- I agree with the credit and the term reset, but let's tighten the discount to 14% (keeps net revenue a bit stronger across the commit).
- The SLA add-on is reasonable as a time-bound accommodation; however, I want the remedy carve to be simpler: make it a service-credit equal to 1% of monthly ARR for each missed month, capped at $20k.
- Require PO or signed amendment before we apply the credit.

This still needs final sign-off from Vivek since the total concession and SLA cap exceed our standard delegation. Vivek — can you weigh in? If approved, please confirm the authorized amounts and I'll instruct Legal to prepare an addendum.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

(On a separate note: let's track this as a retention success metric if we approve.)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — usage drop + budget constraints

Folks — reviewed the ask and the numbers. Approving a modified preservation package but with firm guardrails: 
- One-time credit: $30,000 (approved) to be applied only after we receive a signed PO or amendment and confirmation of the 12-month commit at the adjusted rate.
- Term pricing: approve 14% off list for 12 months (Marissa's recommendation).
- SLA addendum: approve 6-month 99.9% uptime commitment with remedy equal to 1% of monthly ARR per missed month, capped at $20,000. Legal must verify the language; no open-ended liability.

Conditions:
1) Customer must sign the amendment and return the PO by Nov 20.
2) Contract to include a migration/usage review at month 3 and month 6; if usage recovers beyond baseline thresholds we will revert to standard pricing on the subsequent renewal.
3) Finance to log the credit against DL-4539 and mark this as a one-time retention concession.

Jonas — you have my go-ahead to present this offer to Sofia and Mark. Loop in Legal (cc'd by you) and Finance for the amendment and booking.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded to customer (Jonas to send final offer) ---
